name: Prince George of Denmark
role: Consort of Queen Anne from 1702 to 1708
contribution: The husband of Anne, Queen of Great Britain.

checks.lead: Prince George of Denmark and Norway, Duke of Cumberland (Danish: Jørgen; 2 April 1653 – 28 October 1708), was the husband of Anne, Queen of Great Britain. He was the consort of the British monarch from Anne's accession on 8 March 1702 until his death in 1708.
